# 主流向量数据库（如 Elasticsearch、Milvus、Qdrant、Weaviate）对混合检索的支持情况如何？引用官方文档。

以下报告仅综合已通过核验的研究结论，并为每项事实保留可回溯的证据引用。

## Milvus · Filtered / pre-filter behavior

在 AnnSearchRequest 中配置 expr 参数可设置混合搜索的过滤条件 [evidence:3df9304de62183cb01f1245dee4573fa64139284a8421c42] [evidence:ec394174f11b2bb834368ee9515760c5e2e98d5fbedb861d]

## Milvus · Hybrid search support

Milvus 提供 hybrid_search 方法，将稠密向量检索与稀疏向量检索组合在一次查询中并通过 WeightedRanker 重排 [evidence:c8512769f52a2d608a9f46f851d137eb471ac843cac70107] [evidence:e8168ca145db8dc03dee6941ec9170efdc312e037535bb13]

## Milvus · Fusion/scoring method

Milvus 混合检索的 rerank 参数支持 WeightedRanker 和 RRFRanker 两种重排策略 [evidence:25fda6c7e69c7bfe53e77fedd00ce979fb32bb2c3f4360c9] [evidence:dad8e573faa3ed7e6f35e3395068cafaddb2edd5851b3d8f] [evidence:94a7d8bbb90900839346df875ce273aa9f83adcd85c0fa00] [evidence:cfb7856e558f2c98df645426f207f4f93b82179f6858d3c4]

## Milvus · Documentation limitations

混合检索中每个 AnnSearchRequest 仅支持一个查询数据 [evidence:996d64fb4aba21cb40ab3660c25c72f701f1a117ecccb124]

## Milvus · APIs and configuration

Milvus 通过 hybrid_search() 函数中创建多个 AnnSearchRequest 来实现混合检索 [evidence:0ae98e169ff0a162bbd0d3c66e159157ace952b7388836cc] [evidence:b8878f4143aea97c7c66b1e551278a5884d30a8e92ce3cc5]

## Elasticsearch · Filtered / pre-filter behavior

官方文档说明该过滤在近似 kNN 检索过程中生效，以确保返回 k 个匹配文档。 [evidence:447c44506b47b6686f1a50c047e8c7f7adbaa032eb10661e] [evidence:889db18f23eb34eafc13d04dbcb1ae279ad0b90372b75dfd] [evidence:4a0a72274b14f4e6e83b29b9e501804d66d75c0cc4baa434] [evidence:a495e5ed243b96aa9bd7859590d8c43420efd12f62e0955a]

## Elasticsearch · Hybrid search support

Elasticsearch 官方支持混合检索，可在一次请求中同时运行全文检索和向量检索。 [evidence:0b4cb542d65226db7224b6bb1224177ce10972531f962c90] [evidence:b8560191c3a2761beff42b8eb4d7373f5ecacbda43ad4e68] [evidence:01539ea168c7284da101b8966acc9ebf142fa694a9b35638] [evidence:f0a5d96f22d825114d307cae7ff40a36ce7fdd99f433ac52]

## Elasticsearch · Fusion/scoring method

Elasticsearch 推荐使用倒数排名融合（RRF）算法实现混合检索，合并全文检索和向量查询的排名。 [evidence:bbe772e9c11f005912c28eaae14d3ad406206301a409de0d] [evidence:68afb96df1b774f3b046bc3782efa9599631a57919a4602e] [evidence:6afbefa4824201eabf2a759f258eb8bc2cbdb6980b4b29a5] [evidence:d65952e1c1265595e1eaadc26278fe26bc10527578c5040a]

## Elasticsearch · APIs and configuration

Elasticsearch 有两种混合检索方式：query 选项配合 knn 选项，或使用 retriever 搜索选项 [evidence:08e5dbfecdba2c3f2d6fd0ecdb83eb8fc2ae1ec644e27c90] [evidence:0009dcd7a2e713ae38fa58391eeff4fb2970763c9cbc5f20] [evidence:74c9734e51f0e08d7902ff738a56c7a4e7546be513bcbf19] [evidence:ec9a045f78922dc93853913bc3b44f0c18c73d08838ad68d]

## Qdrant · Filtered / pre-filter behavior

Qdrant 的 query planner 会依据过滤选择性选择策略，高匹配时用带节点跳过的 HNSW，极少匹配时对候选做全扫描 [evidence:f78f21d233d3c371654c56df391614de28ee42c826c5ace3] [evidence:527934513f7d20145ad7841bc8778a0882c92859dc17d06f] [evidence:07d8b5916ec89ba664dc32e265358bd00db80a9eac9630ae]

## Qdrant · Hybrid search support

1. **Prefetched** twenty results with dense vector search
2. Then **sparse vectors** were used to rearrange them in an order defined by sparse relevancy scores [evidence:d25049015ed5f54b89b44ca64fd5e6b3200864dd9d370a12] [evidence:8166e8e70f9a592692d6dfe50f625d20143c03f3dc78fb88] [evidence:885294433b2ebb037a89e66ffbc26b3003130ed36668b8ab]

## Qdrant · Fusion/scoring method

Qdrant 的 Query API 提供 RRF 融合查询，通过 Query::new_rrf(RrfBuilder::default()) 使用。 [evidence:0b04cf39be37139bbfba510f98eda5d1eff49fa6351e5d21] [evidence:1b42332a36a842e917210197d61af27ff60fd17452bab41c] [evidence:529a093eebc8adaa0f9a64ac03b5ecc49c0cdea5389d441a]

## Qdrant · Documentation limitations

通用查询 API 是在 Qdrant 1.10 中引入的，因此更早版本不支持该混合检索方式。 [evidence:170548d607a93e29998a7a1e4468d74170aaaec6070fb3f5] [evidence:b9316f3cab8545cc0dbb1f83a9499e3a2713a74f8f64437a]

## Qdrant · APIs and configuration

Qdrant 可通过 gRPC 客户端用 queryAsync 构建 QueryPoints 请求，并用 addPrefetch 添加预取查询 [evidence:31a1834b08cfe8a309f1ab90bb66795beea77f55db9f5642] [evidence:c2901792ab57543ed1a0cda4cfef28dcdb0e7e94981f9799] [evidence:080fa32de9a5bae12ceecfe001a40f4834d93473c9196308]

## Weaviate · Filtered / pre-filter behavior

Weaviate 的过滤向量搜索基于预过滤，过滤器在向量搜索之前构建 [evidence:710d9b09dd0722ea754e0dc73c582aaf4bee276f9b1cb004] [evidence:811b44c2697b94e9967dcfd55ed0c5089bf6f00920a6179c] [evidence:7ee874a2068a577ec1074ad2e24ef67ed3c3aeaa3bc5ae01] [evidence:428b53ea735c2e0bd945b6495a9d3c3ae20149abbd6c991d] [evidence:7e181c380b7213726f7ccf6d5ac05246cf3c4b6b920b1b6e] [evidence:9a037d7454d078be31371e5605a8c236409f0790d883583f]

## Weaviate · Hybrid search support

Weaviate 的混合检索将关键词（BM25）与向量检索结合 [evidence:396cc8022d09cf5bee5d62d4b9890c5f90ff028d0fa87bf0] [evidence:bebc5bd3021f7e63c9bf3c1a69279a2c7d4a2d8cf341a25f] [evidence:90b760b5c0e41ce4e8d579dd67456d616cbba800c9787e98]

## Weaviate · Fusion/scoring method

Weaviate支持两种融合算法，其中relativeScoreFusion自v1.24起为默认方法 [evidence:099aee4fe33733e173d4f0b6a95e763b3ddb8ec8d3c066ce] [evidence:f76d6f396de8169b78f697b9a1ceb3a11a6e3a8f97fcb273] [evidence:f03de4122f3458f75e799cf4e6737db47f150fa3b0b83f9a] [evidence:3e0f632e192b14e71e362b0e29a35b2f80f3af96eacb9929]

## Weaviate · Documentation limitations

Weaviate 混合检索唯一可用的搜索阈值是 max vector distance，只作用于向量检索部分 [evidence:e16baff39de769af113551ebe07967097e10c527dced1f89] [evidence:39077583573ebe69e1bfc0e0311e12ac9c186bc7472f2fd3] [evidence:caebdeab684dfc494da1ec4393999c049cc6480b591ed76f]

## Weaviate · APIs and configuration

hybrid 查询中可用 max_vector_distance 设置向量检索部分的最大距离阈值 [evidence:c5a250f647d13977d4ce23a7883b9f555c7bdf0d46acc22d] [evidence:63e3347120a2c843d9bf908f3d5dff14fb1ce3a450bd1a4d] [evidence:9e0ba4709e5078a290fe6d87a0da9ac11ea81d8937e8ebd6]
